versions.content: Textually formulated content attached to DiagnosticEvent The definition of a DiagnosticEvent also consists of textually formulated content that is formalized in structure but cannot be formalized in content. The purpose of this content is to define e.g. a mature condition that relates to the specific DiagnosticEvent .
